name: South Yorkshire
description: South Yorkshire is a metropolitan county in northern England centred on Sheffield and a network of former industrial towns. It has a strong steel and manufacturing heritage, while the western part reaches into the Peak District's dramatic landscapes.

places.name: Sheffield
places.description: A South Yorkshire city famous worldwide for steel production, particularly cutlery, now reinvented with extensive green space — a third of the city sits within the Peak District — and a strong music heritage.

places.name: Barnsley
places.description: A former coal-mining town in South Yorkshire, its identity still shaped by that industrial heritage even as the pits have long closed. Known for its market, Elsecar Heritage Centre, and strong working-class cultural pride.

places.name: Doncaster
places.description: A South Yorkshire town with deep railway heritage, home to the St Leger Stakes, the world's oldest classic horse race, run at Doncaster Racecourse since 1776.

places.name: Rotherham
places.description: A former steel and coal town in South Yorkshire, home to Magna Science Adventure Centre inside a converted steelworks, and close to Wentworth Woodhouse, one of England's largest private houses.
